title: qxmd214: light/dark contrast - footer, options, toolbar, sol no left line
body: LIGHT footer Prev/Next force dark -webkit-text-fill (not white-on-white). DARK options .qx-opt-plain + KaTeX .mord light text. Remove ALL sol-body/qx-sol/eg-sol border-left. LIGHT toolbar SVG dark fill on chips. DARK solution card dark surface + light headers/ANSWER. Keep transparent foot, Prev|Check|Next, scroll unlock, KaTeX no double-dollar, stem-free.
